full_list.title_en: Recent advances in interfaces and durability of electrochemical cells and electrocatalytic systems
full_list.title_zh: 电化学电池和电催化系统的界面和耐久性的最新进展
full_list.abstract: Batteries, fuel cells, electrolyzers and electrocatalytic reactors are usually discussed separately, yet they tend to fail at the same kind of place: an interface. This review draws on 102 open-access articles published between 2019 and 2026, follows that thread across cells and catalysts, and collects the quantitative findings reported in them. Inorganic solid electrolytes span conductivities of 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻² S cm⁻¹ depending on class, and the sulfides that reach the highest values are prone to interface and moisture problems. Electrolyzers run at 40–90°C in liquid-alkaline, anion-exchange and proton-exchange cells and at 600–850°C in solid-oxide cells. For oxygen evolution in alkaline media, a nickel–iron oxyhydroxide needs overpotentials of 251 and 291 mV at 100 and 500 mA cm⁻² and runs for more than 300 h, and a cobalt–ferrocene framework needs about 190 mV at 10 mA cm⁻²; both are formed by reconstruction of a precatalyst during operation. Single-atom catalysts approach 100% atom utilization, yet the longest laboratory stability test quoted here, over 300 h, is under 0.4% of the 80,000 h lifetime targeted for PEM electrolyzers. In CO₂ electrolyzers, current densities above 200 mA cm⁻² are reached, but salt precipitation limits operation. We compare six catalyst families together with operando characterization and machine learning, and conclude that standardized reporting, device-relevant testing and assignment of activity to the working state now matter more than new compositions.

full_list.title_en: Hybrid Constraint Generation for the Feedback Vertex Set Problem under QAOA
full_list.title_zh: QAOA下反馈顶点集问题的混合约束生成
full_list.abstract: The Feedback Vertex Set} (FVS) problem asks for a minimum-cardinality set of vertices whose removal makes a graph acyclic. A natural integer-programming formulation enforces one constraint per cycle, but enumerating all simple cycles quickly becomes a bottleneck when constructing QUBO and Ising Hamiltonians. We study undirected graphs and present a hybrid constraint-generation pipeline that starts from a compact minimum-cycle-basis encoding, uses the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) as a heuristic candidate generator, and augments the constraint set only when the residual graph exposes a violated cycle. A lightweight classical verification and pruning stage ensures that the final reported solution is a valid FVS. The study centers on the tradeoff between compact encodings and explicit repair: minimum-cycle-basis constraints reduce binary-variable overhead, but they do not in general enforce all cycle-hitting inequalities, so an iterative augmentation loop remains necessary. We therefore frame the method as a hybrid constrained-optimization workflow rather than a claim of quantum advantage, and evaluate it through simulator-based case studies, exact classical references on small instances, and resource metrics that track constraint growth and slack-variable overhead.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反馈顶点集（FVS）问题要求顶点的最小基数集，将其删除会使图成为非循环。自然的整数规划公式对每个周期强制执行一个约束，但在构造 QUBO 和伊辛哈密顿量时，枚举所有简单周期很快就会成为瓶颈。我们研究无向图并提出一种混合约束生成管道，该管道从紧凑的最小循环基础编码开始，使用量子近似优化算法（QAOA）作为启发式候选生成器，并且仅当残差图暴露违反循环时才增加约束集。轻量级经典验证和修剪阶段确保最终报告的解决方案是有效的 FVS。

full_list.title_en: Theoretical model describes a new type of atomic oscillation with cloverleaf symmetry in altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 理论模型描述了交替磁体中具有三叶草对称性的新型原子振荡
full_list.abstract: A team of researchers at Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg (MLU) and the University of Münster has discovered a new type of atomic oscillation in altermagnets, which exhibit a striking cloverleaf symmetry. The findings were published in the journal Physical Review Letters.
full_list.abstract_zh: 哈雷-维滕贝格马丁路德大学 (MLU) 和明斯特大学的一组研究人员在交流磁体中发现了一种新型原子振荡，这种振荡表现出惊人的三叶草对称性。研究结果发表在《物理评论快报》杂志上。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《理论模型描述了交替磁体中具有三叶草对称性的新型原子振荡》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.abstract: Optics and photonics study the sciences of electromagnetic waves, which were well formulated by Maxwell’s equations more than 160 years ago. However, surprisingly, the fundamental problem of experimentally measuring an electromagnetic wave with all necessary electric field information in one go is yet to be realized. Instead, only limited physical quantities describing an optical wave can be picked out and measured, such as intensity, phase, spectrum, polarization, and their spatial or/and temporal profile. Here we demonstrate a single-shot three-dimensional (3D) spatiotemporal visualization of an electromagnetic wave packet in the terahertz (THz) spectral regime, unveiling complete spatiotemporal properties of light, including the three complete electric field components Ex, Ey and Ez, and their carrier-envelope phases. To capture such a 3D snapshot, the THz wave packet information is imprinted in a whole on a chirped ultrafast near-infrared probe laser pulse through electro-optic sampling, and extracted from the optical probe via a proposed technique of single-shot full-Stokes compressive spatiospectral polarimetry. 3D snapshots of electromagnetic wave packets not only solve the fundamental problem of seeing the traveling wave solution to Maxwell’s equations, but also open the door to holistic optical wave sensing.

full_list.title_en: ANKA-M: a magnetospheric antiproton collector spacecraft concept for Earth's radiation belt – sizing, collection upper bound, power and trajectory analysis
full_list.title_zh: ANKA-M：用于地球辐射带的磁层反质子收集器航天器概念 - 尺寸确定、收集上限、功率和轨迹分析
full_list.abstract: Producing antiprotons on the ground is extremely inefficient, whereas a population of antiprotons magnetically trapped in Earth's inner radiation belt has been measured directly by the PAMELA satellite. This paper sizes a spacecraft concept, ANKA-M, that collects this natural source with its own magnetic field alone, without plasma assistance. The core of the design is a high-temperature-superconductor ring 100 m in diameter carrying 10⁷ ampere-turns (central field 0.126 T, stored energy 5.6 MWh). For 200 MeV antiprotons the Størmer radius is 60 m; at the modelled peak flux of the belt the upper bound on the collection rate is 2.3 ng per year, the same order as the modelled natural replenishment of the belt. The annihilation energy of this harvest (0.41 MJ) would feed a 50 kW spacecraft load for about 8 s, so the collected antimatter cannot power the ship; power comes from 1000 m² of solar arrays (408 kW) and propulsion from ion engines (18 N). An Earth gravity assist gives at most about 7.7 km/s per pass. A pass at the 9.86 solar radii reached by Parker Solar Probe implies 192 km/s, 647 kW/m² and a shield temperature near 1600 K, while plasma heating is negligible; however, the Sun is not an antiproton source, so such a pass serves the Oberth manoeuvre rather than collection. The value of the concept lies in supplying antiprotons for antihydrogen and fundamental-physics experiments. All numbers are calculations or published values, not measurements.

full_list.title_en: Graphene-Tunable Broadband Reflective Metasurface for Terahertz Polarization Conversion and Refractive-Index Biosensing
full_list.title_zh: 用于太赫兹偏振转换和折射率生物传感的石墨烯可调谐宽带反射超表面
full_list.abstract: Broadband operation, high conversion efficiency, electrical tunability, and sensing functionality are often challenges that must be met simultaneously in refractive-index sensors and terahertz polarization converters. We propose a small graphene-based reflective metasurface for refractive-index sensing and multifunctional terahertz polarization conversion. The proposed structure includes a polyimide dielectric spacer, an aluminum ground plane, asymmetric aluminum resonating elements, and a graphene layer that provides an electrically tunable electromagnetic response. The designed structural asymmetry and strong resonant coupling enable effective dual-band broadband polarization conversion, with a polarization conversion ratio (PCR) over 90% across two frequency bands, 6.108–10.773 THz and 11.648–14.051 THz. This results in a total bandwidth of 7.068 THz with an average PCR of 95.98%. full_list.abstract: We investigate a proposed ZnO/ZnS/GaP heterojunction solar cell incorpo rating 50-nm gold nanoparticles into the ZnO electron-transport layer. The analysis combines a 5×5 electromagnetic parameter sweep, a bicubic surro gate model, and Monte Carlo sampling (N = 5,000) to assess how variations in nanoparticle size and spacing affect the modeled photovoltaic performance. The reference and plasmonic configurations yield short-circuit current den sities of 8.9 and 12.5 mA cm−2, respectively, corresponding to a 40.4% in crease. The plasmonic configuration reaches 92.6% of the adopted photocur rent benchmark of 13.5 mA cm−2. This benchmark should not be confused with the Shockley–Queisser efficiency limit. Because the reported 95% pre diction interval extends above the benchmark, the present ensemble does not establish compliance with this bound for every realization. The plasmonic configuration achieves a modeled efficiency of 6.66%, substantially below the cited radiative-limit efficiency of approximately 21.5%. When the electrical parameters are held fixed, 84.3% of geometry-only realizations exceed 6.0% efficiency; independent sampling of the electrical parameters broadens the predicted distribution. These probabilities depend on the assumed input distributions, surrogate-model accuracy, and single-diode formulation and should not be interpreted as experimental manufacturing yields. The spec tral subband contributions are estimates obtained from a fitted retention envelope rather than independent FDTD calculations. Additional electro magnetic, electrical, and experimental validation is therefore required before these predictions can be considered reliable.

full_list.abstract: The Hall effect, a physical phenomenon in which a current arises perpendicular to a voltage applied across a material, has been of particular interest to physicists since it was discovered more than a century ago. Over time, physicists have broadened their understanding of the Hall effect, describing quantum and anomalous versions that appear under nonclassical conditions. Recently, Rice University's Qimiao Si published a paper in Physical Review Letters describing a new variant called the fully nonequilibrium response that once again expands how physicists understand the Hall effect.

full_list.title_en: Non-equilibrium Muon Dynamics Imitating Fractional Spin Excitations in a Quantum Spin Chain

full_list.abstract: Fractional spin excitations in low-dimensional and frustrated magnets are commonly associated with sporadic spin fluctuations, as observed in quantum spin liquids, spin ices, and other complex magnetic states. In this study, we investigate the spin dynamics in the amplitude-modulated magnetic ground state of AgCuVO4, a spin-1/2 chain compound with competing intrachain interactions, by muon spectroscopy. Our data reveal a Gaussian decay of muon polarization that remains remarkably resilient against applied magnetic fields–a behavior often interpreted as evidence of emergent sporadic spin dynamics. However, density functional theory calculations of muon stopping sites and their quadrupolar level-crossing resonance spectra suggest an alternative mechanism: a two-state model where the muon randomly hops between two nearby sites, eventually equilibrating across both on a microsecond timescale via quantum delocalization. These findings provide a microscopic explanation for the field-resilient muon polarization and indicate that such behavior may not always stem from intrinsic spin fluctuations, but can also arise from non-equilibrium muon dynamics.

full_list.title_en: Tunnel-Barrier Control of Ultrafast Demagnetization and Spin Transport in Graphene/TiOx/Co Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 石墨烯/TiOx/Co异质结构中超快退磁和自旋输运的隧道势垒控制
full_list.abstract: Heterostructures combining graphene with 3d transition metal ferromagnets (FMs) enable various spin-based phenomena at ultrafast timescales. However, challenges such as the interfacial impedance mismatch, FM deposition-induced defect generation, and interface modification by interfacial coupling or hybridization can impede their functionalization for spin-orbitronics. In this work, we utilize insulating TiOx barrier layers to modify the interfacial spin conductance structurally, disentangle spin pumping and magnetic proximity effects, and establish external control over ultrafast magnetization dynamics in single-layer graphene/TiOx/Co systems. All-optical time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect measurements of femtosecond to nanosecond spin dynamics reveal systematic tunability of ultrafast magnetic parameters via barrier engineering. The thickness-dependent modulation of Co damping indicates efficient spin pumping, with substantial interfacial spin transparency retained even in the presence of an ultrathin TiOx barrier. Notably, a 0.8 nm TiOx barrier suppresses the magnetic proximity effect while allowing spin transfer into graphene. These findings demonstrate that tunnel-barrier engineering can help separate proximity-induced magnetism from spin transport, providing a practical route to control ultrafast magnetization dynamics in graphene-based heterostructures.

full_list.title_en: Quantum-QRIS: A Quantum-Safe Trust Architecture for Merchant-Bound Static and Dynamic QR Payments
full_list.title_zh: Quantum-QRIS：用于商户绑定静态和动态二维码支付的量子安全信任架构
full_list.abstract: QR-based payment systems offer low-cost deployment and broad interoperability, but visual QR artifacts do not inherently prove that the encoded recipient is the intended merchant or that displayed payment evidence reflects an authoritative transaction. This creates a trust gap that persists even when the payment rail itself functions correctly, while financial infrastructures must also prepare for migration to quantum-resistant cryptography. This study proposes and experimentally evaluates Quantum-QRIS, a merchant-bound post-quantum trust architecture for static and dynamic QR payments. Its novelty lies in decoupling compact customer-facing QR artifacts from online trust resolution so that merchant identity, transaction freshness, lifecycle state, post-quantum authentication, quantum-safe key establishment, payment completion, and fraud evidence are jointly resolved through a reusable Quantum-Safe Security as a Service (QSSaaS) backend. The architecture integrates ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768, hybrid QRNG/OS-CSPRNG freshness, replay and expiry controls, merchant lifecycle validation, and authoritative payment-state verification. A design-science methodology was used to implement and evaluate the prototype through functional/security validation and three benchmark runs. In the main same-network benchmark (n=300), all core signing, verification, nonce, merchant, static QR, HTTP static, and EDC creation operations achieved 100% success. Mean service-path latency was 515.79 ms for ML-DSA signing, 497.85 ms for verification, and 2366.76 ms for EDC creation. Full-payment completion reached 76% for static payments and 69% for EDC payments. The results show that quantum-safe QR-payment security is a systems problem requiring cryptographic assurance, merchant and transaction-state binding, lifecycle enforcement, and explicit treatment of physical-context limitations.

full_list.title_en: Band-dependent charging governs electrochemical energetics in two-dimensional materials
full_list.title_zh: 能带相关的充电控制着二维材料的电化学能量学
full_list.abstract: Accurately predicting the electrochemical energetics of two-dimensional (2D) materials as electrode potential varies is critical for understanding interfacial processes underlying electrocatalysis and rechargeable batteries. However, the conventional single-quadratic model (CSQM), widely used for metallic/semimetallic systems, cannot capture distinct charging behaviors arising from separated valence and conduction bands in semiconductors. Here, we reveal band-dependent charging as a general feature of 2D materials and establish its connection to their intrinsic electronic characteristics. We therefore develop a dual-quadratic model (DQM) that separately captures valence- and conduction-band charging behaviors, enabling continuous prediction of potential-dependent energetics across metallic, semimetallic, and semiconducting 2D materials. Using only 6 discrete grand canonical density functional theory (GC-DFT) calculations, the DQM predicts potential-dependent adsorption energy profiles matching densely sampled GC-DFT benchmarks (RMSE ~ 0.055 eV), whereas the CSQM exhibits errors of up to 80%. These findings establish band-dependent charging as a governing principle of electrochemical energetics in 2D materials.

full_list.title_zh: 山楂酸和齐墩果酸针对参与葡萄糖和脂质代谢的蛋白质靶标的计算机比较评估
full_list.abstract: Maslinic and oleanolic acids are olive-derived triterpenes with potential metabolic and antidiabetic activity, but their interactions with individual protein targets remain incompletely defined. We compared their predicted binding to 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1, protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B, peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor α, and farnesoid X receptor using molecular docking and triplicate molecular dynamics. Reference-ligand and control systems were included, yielding 48 independent 100 ns trajectories and 4.8 µs of aggregate sampling. Both candidates retained contacts with the targeted pockets in all replicas. Farnesoid X receptor and proximal site B of protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B showed comparatively reproducible association, whereas peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor α displayed greater pose heterogeneity. Maslinic acid maintained a conserved Ser170 anchor in 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1, while oleanolic acid depended more strongly on cofactor contacts. Residue-resolved fluctuations revealed local and terminal variability obscured by whole-protein averages. Molecular mechanics/Poisson–Boltzmann surface area scores did not establish a reliable affinity ranking between the candidates. Projected free-energy landscapes revealed replica-dependent conformational populations. The results support target-specific binding hypotheses and show how persistent local interactions coexist with heterogeneous protein conformations. These findings prioritise target-specific functional assays and pose validation without establishing inhibition, agonism, or antidiabetic efficacy.

full_list.title_en: Assessing the distribution and condition of wooden roofs in Slovenia through citizen science and complementary analytical methods
full_list.title_zh: 通过公民科学和补充分析方法评估斯洛文尼亚木屋顶的分布和状况
full_list.abstract: Wooden roofs are an important component of Slovenia’s and Alpine architectural heritage, but conserving them requires information on distribution, moisture performance, and maintenance practices. This study combined citizen science, remote mapping, laboratory testing, outdoor moisture monitoring, and elemental characterisation. A citizen science inventory documented 130 structures, concentrated in Alpine and pre-Alpine regions; pastoral buildings accounted for 40.8% of records. Remote mapping, seems more effective and identified about 280 candidate wooden-roof features in the Velika Planina area, providing complementary coverage but requiring verification of potential misclassifications. Roofs were traditionally made of split shingles, which are nowadays replaced by sawn ones. To compare the moisture performance of these two materials, laboratory immersion and spraying tests showed that split shingles wetted more than sawn spruce shingles. Outdoor monitoring yielded similar outcomes, without a consistent advantage across elevated-moisture thresholds. Unfortunately, shingles are frequently treated with waste lubricant oil. Thus, portable X-ray fluorescence measurements on 30 cabins, supported by microscopy and micro-XRF, revealed surface deposits consistent with reported waste lubricating oil treatments. Principal component analysis differentiated treatment groups, supporting its application for exploratory screening. Iron and sulfur accumulated predominantly near shingle surfaces. Deterioration is accompanied with moisture content increase. These findings support integrated inventories, moisture-conscious roof detailing, and environmentally appropriate maintenance, while identifying waste-oil application as a potential contamination source requiring direct environmental assessment to quantify releases and impacts.

full_list.title_en: Open-Water UAV Small-Object Detection via Re-parameterized Convolutions and Context- Guided Fusion

full_list.abstract: Object detection for open-water search and rescue is a critical entry point in the perception pipeline. Constrained by UAV payload and onboard computer, existing detectors already offer competitive speed and accuracy; however, they still struggle in real open-water scenes. Swimmers and life-saving devices typically appear as tiny objects with weak texture and blurred boundaries, while wave patterns and specular reflections continuously generate high-response background pseudo-structures, leading to both missed detections and false alarms. To address these challenges, we develop an efficient end-to-end detector tailored to open-water scenarios, improving tiny-object visibility and background suppression without relying on complex post-processing. Our network first introduces a re-parameterizable multi-branch convolutional representation and cross-layer reuse in the backbone to strengthen fine-grained edge/shape cues while preserving a compact inference path. We then employ a channel-partitioned subspace self-attention strategy in high-level semantic encoding to impose necessary long-range dependencies at low overhead and to reduce cross-region spurious associations triggered by sea-surface pseudo-structures. Building on this, we further design a context-guided selective cross-scale feature pyramid that injects semantic information into high-resolution branches in a more controlled manner, mitigating the cumulative amplification of noise along the multi-scale propagation pathway. We evaluated the effectiveness of the proposed method through experiments. Compared with RT-DETR-R18, our approach improves (:mAP@0.5)and (:mAP@0.5:0.95) by 4.73 and 6.34 percentage points, respectively, while reducing the parameter count by approximately 19.9%. These results indicate that the proposed design achieves a more favorable accuracy and efficiency trade-off by simultaneously boosting detection performance and lowering model complexity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 开放水域搜索和救援的物体检测是感知管道中的关键切入点。受无人机有效载荷和机载计算机的限制，现有探测器已经提供了具有竞争力的速度和精度；然而，他们在真正的开放水域场景中仍然挣扎。游泳者和救生设备通常显示为纹理较弱且边界模糊的微小物体，而波浪图案和镜面反射不断生成高响应背景伪结构，导致漏检和误报。为了应对这些挑战，我们开发了一种针对开放水域场景的高效端到端探测器，无需依赖复杂的后处理即可提高微小物体的可见性和背景抑制。

full_list.title_en: Weissella spp. from traditionally fermented ponni rice: Exopolysaccharide production and probiotic attributes for starter culture development
full_list.title_zh: 威斯氏菌属来自传统发酵的庞尼米：用于发酵剂开发的胞外多糖生产和益生菌特性
full_list.abstract: Probiotic autochthonous bacteria isolated from fermented foods represent potential candidates for functional starter cultures development. In the curent study, Weissella confusa and Weissella cibaria were identified as lactic acid bacterial isolates from traditionally fermented Ponni rice using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Both isolates showed probiotic properties, efficient maintaining viable bacterial populations of > 5.8 log CFU mL-1under acidic conditions (pH 3.0), bile salts, simulated gastric juice, and pancreatin. W. cibaria exhibited greater tolerance to gastrointestinal stress. W. confusa had significantly higher auto-aggregation (43.65 ± 0.06%), cell surface hydrophobicity (37.76 ± 0.32%) and exopolysaccharide production (165.95 ± 2.34 mg glucose equivalent L⁻¹). Both isolates were found to be γ-haemolytic, in terms of their susceptibility to clinically relevant antibiotics, and produced heat-stable antimicrobial metabolites with inhibition zones measuring ~18-25 mm against Staphylococcus aureus and Salmonella typhi. HPLC analysis indicated the production of lactic, acetic acid (~1.0 g L-1) tartaric acid (~0.2gL-1) and vitamin profiling suggested the presence of pantothenic acid (vitamin B5) in both Weissella isolates. GC-MS analysis of W. confusa indicated that the isolate is capable of producing several bioactive metabolites, such as azulene (19.85%), tetradecanoic acid (15.58%), cis-11-eicosenamide (11.45%), and pentadecanoic acid (4.10%). These results indicate that the two autochthonous Weissella isolates show complementary probiotic and metabolic characteristics, with W. confusa showing better exopolysaccharide production and metabolite diversity, which validates its use as a multifunctional probiotic starter culture and natural bio preservative for cereal-based fermented foods.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从发酵食品中分离出的益生菌本土细菌代表了功能性发酵剂开发的潜在候选者。在当前的研究中，利用 16S rRNA 基因测序，将 Weissella confusa 和 Weissella cibaria 鉴定为从传统发酵 Ponni 大米中分离出来的乳酸菌。两种分离株均显示出益生菌特性，在酸性条件（pH 3.0）、胆汁盐、模拟胃液和胰酶条件下，可有效维持 > 5.8 log CFU mL-1 的活菌群。 W. cibaria 对胃肠道应激表现出更强的耐受性。

full_list.title_en: Machine-learned syndrome post-selection for reliable quantum error correction
full_list.title_zh: 用于可靠量子纠错的机器学习综合症后选择
full_list.abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) can be enhanced by post-selecting out runs that are likely to produce a logical failure, but the most accurate measures for that require costly decoder-level information. We introduce a practical, decoder-agnostic post-selection method that learns directly from syndrome data. The method trains a supervised classifier to distinguish between syndromes from low- and high-noise regimes, and then uses the classifier’s output as an abort score for new runs, without requiring logical-error labels, correction operators, or code-specific likelihood calculations. We validate the approach in three complementary settings: circuit-level simulations of the Gross bivariate-bicycle code, code-capacity simulations of the surface code, and experimental logical magic-state distillation data from the QuEra neutral-atom processor (Sales Rodriguez et al 2025 Nature645 620). In the Gross and surface codes, learned syndrome post-selection reduces the conditional logical error rate at a fixed acceptance rate, with performance comparable to syndrome-weight (SW) filtering. For the surface code, the learned classifier reveals a post-selection transition distinct from the conventional decoding threshold. In the experimental data, the machine-learning score outperforms SW post-selection and, when combined with logical-gap (LG) filtering, improves the output fidelity beyond using the LG alone. These results show that syndrome-only learning provides a scalable and hardware-compatible route to improving the reliability of QEC.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子纠错（QEC）可以通过后选择可能产生逻辑故障的运行来增强，但最准确的措施需要昂贵的解码器级信息。我们引入了一种实用的、与解码器无关的后选择方法，可以直接从综合症数据中学习。该方法训练监督分类器来区分低噪声和高噪声状态下的综合症，然后使用分类器的输出作为新运行的中止分数，而不需要逻辑错误标签、校正运算符或特定于代码的似然计算。

full_list.title_en: Transformer-based Light Curve Inversion for Spacecraft Attitude Classification and Estimation from Photometric Data
full_list.title_zh: 基于变压器的光曲线反演用于航天器姿态分类和光度数据估计
full_list.abstract: As space activities continue to expand, robust and efficient attitude estimation has become central for Space Situational Awareness (SSA). This work introduces a novel transformer-based architecture to tackle the light curve inversion problem for spacecraft attitude and angular velocity determination. By exploiting the self-attention mechanism, the model captures complex temporal dependencies in photometric time series and directly reconstructs spacecraft attitude and angular velocity histories from observed light curves. The approach is trained and tested on a synthetic dataset of light curves generated using a high-fidelity simulator, considering tumbling, spin, nadir-pointing, and Sun-pointing motion regimes, as observed from several ground-based stations. An initial classification stage based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) distinguishes tumbling and spinning attitude modes from nadir/Sun-pointing regimes, achieving an accuracy of approximately 98%. A subsequent transformer-based regression task reconstructs the full time histories of spacecraft attitude and angular velocity, reaching an average attitude error of less than 1 deg in geodesic distance and an angular velocity magnitude error in the order of 10 −2 deg/s associated with a direction error of approximately 0.54 deg. In addition, a random forest permutation 1 importance analysis is carried out to analyze the relative importance of several features, providing insights into which observational and temporal characteristics most strongly influence the model’s performance. The results highlight the potential of transformer-based architectures to address the challenges associated with the light curve inversion problem for attitude and angular velocity estimation , marking an advancement in the application of machine learning techniques to complex Space Situational Awareness problems.

full_list.title_en: Three-Dimensional Finite Element Modeling and Machine-Learning Surrogate Prediction of Stevia Assisted Osmotic Dehydration of Mango Slices
full_list.title_zh: 甜叶菊辅助芒果片渗透脱水的三维有限元建模和机器学习替代预测
full_list.abstract: Osmotic dehydration (OD) is a food preservation technique that entails the transfer of water from the fruit tissue to the osmotic medium, with the migration of soluble substances from the osmotic medium into the fruit. This research used a 3D finite-element (FE) model to investigate the simultaneous transport of water and solute from stevia, aiming to replicate water loss (WL) and solute gain (SG), and included machine-learning (ML) surrogate models for fast predictions of WL and SG. Transient mass transfer was computed in the COMSOL Multiphysics framework for 18 hours over solution concentrations of (5,7 and 10) °Brix, and temperatures of (304,314 and 323) K. The model successfully simulated the gradual development of concentration gradients from the mango-solution boundary to the center, with a decline in water concentration as solute concentration increased over time. The average water concentration decreased from about 49,700 to 47,300 mol m⁻³, while the average concentration of solutes rose from about 188 to 250 mol m− 3. The extraction of water increased with higher solution concentration and temperature, maximum at 304 K under the examined model circumstances with total solute accumulation. In the grouped cross-validation, CatBoost's RMSE values were 0.58411 on WL and 0.10318 on SG; in the independent test, they were 0.4772 on WL and 0.1028 on SG. The integrated FE - ML approach enables spatially interpretable transport analysis and efficient response prediction to help design and screen processes throughout the explored operating region.

core_items.title_en: Hybrid Constraint Generation for the Feedback Vertex Set Problem under QAOA
core_items.title_zh: QAOA下反馈顶点集问题的混合约束生成
core_items.abstract: The Feedback Vertex Set} (FVS) problem asks for a minimum-cardinality set of vertices whose removal makes a graph acyclic. A natural integer-programming formulation enforces one constraint per cycle, but enumerating all simple cycles quickly becomes a bottleneck when constructing QUBO and Ising Hamiltonians. We study undirected graphs and present a hybrid constraint-generation pipeline that starts from a compact minimum-cycle-basis encoding, uses the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) as a heuristic candidate generator, and augments the constraint set only when the residual graph exposes a violated cycle. A lightweight classical verification and pruning stage ensures that the final reported solution is a valid FVS. The study centers on the tradeoff between compact encodings and explicit repair: minimum-cycle-basis constraints reduce binary-variable overhead, but they do not in general enforce all cycle-hitting inequalities, so an iterative augmentation loop remains necessary. We therefore frame the method as a hybrid constrained-optimization workflow rather than a claim of quantum advantage, and evaluate it through simulator-based case studies, exact classical references on small instances, and resource metrics that track constraint growth and slack-variable overhead.
core_items.abstract_zh: 反馈顶点集（FVS）问题要求顶点的最小基数集，将其删除会使图成为非循环。自然的整数规划公式对每个周期强制执行一个约束，但在构造 QUBO 和伊辛哈密顿量时，枚举所有简单周期很快就会成为瓶颈。我们研究无向图并提出一种混合约束生成管道，该管道从紧凑的最小循环基础编码开始，使用量子近似优化算法（QAOA）作为启发式候选生成器，并且仅当残差图暴露违反循环时才增加约束集。轻量级经典验证和修剪阶段确保最终报告的解决方案是有效的 FVS。

core_items.title_en: Recent advances in interfaces and durability of electrochemical cells and electrocatalytic systems
core_items.title_zh: 电化学电池和电催化系统的界面和耐久性的最新进展
core_items.abstract: Batteries, fuel cells, electrolyzers and electrocatalytic reactors are usually discussed separately, yet they tend to fail at the same kind of place: an interface. This review draws on 102 open-access articles published between 2019 and 2026, follows that thread across cells and catalysts, and collects the quantitative findings reported in them. Inorganic solid electrolytes span conductivities of 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻² S cm⁻¹ depending on class, and the sulfides that reach the highest values are prone to interface and moisture problems. Electrolyzers run at 40–90°C in liquid-alkaline, anion-exchange and proton-exchange cells and at 600–850°C in solid-oxide cells. For oxygen evolution in alkaline media, a nickel–iron oxyhydroxide needs overpotentials of 251 and 291 mV at 100 and 500 mA cm⁻² and runs for more than 300 h, and a cobalt–ferrocene framework needs about 190 mV at 10 mA cm⁻²; both are formed by reconstruction of a precatalyst during operation. Single-atom catalysts approach 100% atom utilization, yet the longest laboratory stability test quoted here, over 300 h, is under 0.4% of the 80,000 h lifetime targeted for PEM electrolyzers. In CO₂ electrolyzers, current densities above 200 mA cm⁻² are reached, but salt precipitation limits operation. We compare six catalyst families together with operando characterization and machine learning, and conclude that standardized reporting, device-relevant testing and assignment of activity to the working state now matter more than new compositions.
